gaps.message: journeys across several forms — End-to-end workflows are taken from recorded journeys. They are not inferred from discovery, because the order of real business steps is not visible in the page.
Clinic Scheduler (/schedule): navigation to the page — Discovery reached this page by its address (a listed route, the sitemap or the start page), not by clicking, so no click path is known.

keyboard order through the whole form — The form starts with, or soon reaches, a control that handles Tab itself (a date, a radio group or a file input), so the order past it is not checked automatically.
